plan.performanceScope: Five recorded groups after one predeclared discarded group; all six three-variant permutations. Primary contrast Native candidate versus Native control in fixed per-role environments; candidate JIT is reference. Direct immutable local image IDs. Original private historical inputs unavailable; no historical reconstruction or isolated component speedup claim.
plan.memoryScope: Docker container memory display sampled at readiness and after both full probes, outside measured request windows. No forced GC or sampled peak claim.
plan.coldReadinessScope: Host wrapper stopwatch from immediately before docker run until successful readiness; includes Docker launch and polling. Per-host raw timestamps retained; not an application-only startup measurement.
plan.reportScope: Custom outer experiment schema, with each original schema2 probe report retained byte-for-byte; does not mislabel a second Native arm as JIT.
plan.unusedCandidateJitImage: c20d6969 RID-publish candidate was never used for any business request; replaced before freeze by standard no-RID Dockerfile reference.
plan.variantEnvironment: Native control/candidate same SDK401/runtime12 and exact OS base-layer prefix, UID1654. JIT reference standard no-RID Dockerfile, exact SDK401/runtime12 base layers, UID1000. Per-role differences explicit; Native before/after is primary contrast.

objective.definition: Candidate Native median SSE RPS at least JIT reference and median of per-run p99 no worse; before/after changes and all five directions retained. Five groups do not establish statistical significance or reconstruct unavailable historical inputs.

scope: All18 original samples retained including predeclared discarded group0. Recorded metrics are five full per-run workload observations per variant; per-run percentiles are not pooled.
